system.description:
All creatures of your choice within 30 feet who are not blind when this jutsu is cast and at the beginning of each of their turns must make a Wisdom saving throw or risk seeing a vile draconic image of your description.

Creatures whom can see the dragon, that you score a successful attack against, see the illusory dragon performing the attack itself. The affected creature suffers Draconic Madness until the end of their next turn. This unique condition is treated as a Mental.

Draconic Madness. This effect applies the effects of 1 rank of Demoralize and 1 rank of Sealed.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, Draconic Madness lasts for 1 minute or until removed.
